Below are the birth years of the **last five solo winners** (excluding collaborative pairs or firms) based on publicly available information up to 2023:

1. **Riken Yamamoto** (2023 winner) – Born 1951  
2. **Diébédo Francis Kéré** (2022 winner) – Born 1965  
3. **Arata Isozaki** (2019 winner) – Born 1931  
4. **Balkrishna Doshi** (2018 winner) – Born 1927  
5. **Alejandro Aravena** (2016 winner) – Born 1964  

*Note: The 2020 and 2021 winners (Yvonne Farrell/Shelley McNamara and Anne Lacaton/Jean-Philippe Vassal, respectively) were awarded as collaborative pairs, so they are excluded from the "solo" list. Birth years are based on widely reported public records.*
